bug_semantics: A request to the Admin Console /download/log endpoint with contentSourceId=LogViewer could supply restUrl. LogViewerContentSource.getInputStream trusted that request parameter as the base URL, appended /view-log/, and issued a server-side GET; RestUtil.getRequestFromServlet also attached the authenticated session's REST_TOKEN cookie and DownloadServlet returned the fetched stream. An attacker able to drive that request could therefore make GlassFish contact arbitrary/internal hosts, observe returned content for network discovery, and potentially disclose the REST administration token to an attacker-controlled origin.
flaw_origin: The legacy GlassFish change for GLASSFISH-17931 created LogViewerContentSource and, in the same commit, added RestUtil.getRequestFromServlet. It made the client-controlled restUrl parameter the outbound request origin without validation or origin binding, while the helper forwarded the session REST token to that origin. The safe origin already existed as session REST_URL; the flaw was choosing request input instead.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer exactly as andriy.zhdanov <andriy.zhdanov@6f3ba3e3-413c-0410-a8aa-90bee3ab43b5>; its message is 'GLASSFISH-17931: Raw log viewer through LogViewerContentSource' followed only by 'git-svn-id: https://svn.java.net/svn/glassfish~svn/trunk/main@52295 6f3ba3e3-413c-0410-a8aa-90bee3ab43b5'. There is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, bot author, or bot committer marker.
evidence: Advisory: the first-party Eclipse report https://gitlab.eclipse.org/security/vulnerability-reports/-/work_items/239 identifies GlassFish 6.2.5, /download/log, restUrl, payload https://localhost:4848, and SSRF effects including internal-service access/port scanning; the Eclipse CVE assignment is https://gitlab.eclipse.org/security/cve-assignment/-/work_items/38. The bundled GitHub advisory https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f7h5-c625-3795 records org.glassfish.main.admingui:console-common <=6.2.5 and no first patched version. Mechanism: at tag 6.2.5 (peeled commit 0159b68b362c7f4be78d1fa75aeaf2ec0b997f1d), appserver/admingui/common/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admingui/common/servlet/LogViewerContentSource.java:59 reads request.getParameter("restUrl") and line 66 builds restUrl + "/view-log/"; RestUtil.java:800-806 gets AdminConsoleAuthModule.REST_TOKEN from the session, targets that endpoint, attaches the token cookie, and GETs it; appserver/admingui/war/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/web.xml maps DownloadServlet to /download/*. History: git log -L 57,69 and git log -S'restUrl' in the assigned clone show the vulnerable lines entering only through root aggregate 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb ('Initial Contribution', 30,345 files/3,141,323 insertions) and being removed by baa1bb56b137773a6ca921a35c60d32414a68f2f. Because that root is not a smallest BIC, preserved pre-Eclipse GlassFish git-svn history was decomposed: https://github.com/payara/Payara/commit/8d7b7ae8846487c31b375426c8babde8f1024f18 is original GlassFish SVN r52295 and adds LogViewerContentSource.java with both exact vulnerable lines plus the token-forwarding helper. Direct parent proof: the BIC object gives parent 25567105f6d0b29facc017f86531677228cf74c1; git ls-tree -r of that parent for the path returned no entry, and git diff --name-status parent..BIC reported A for LogViewerContentSource.java. Version boundary: 6.2.5 contains the flaw, satisfying the reported product/version; repository tag checks additionally show the identical vulnerable endpoint in 7.0.0, 7.0.25, 7.0.26, 7.1.0, and 7.1.1, so the public advisory's <=6.2.5/no-patch metadata is narrower and stale relative to source history. Fix: https://github.com/eclipse-ee4j/glassfish/commit/baa1bb56b137773a6ca921a35c60d32414a68f2f (PR https://github.com/eclipse-ee4j/glassfish/pull/26081) deletes the request restUrl and instead uses session REST_URL. git tag --contains finds that fix only in 8.0.4 and 9.0.0-M3; tag-state checks show 8.0.3 (00c8ff1c98b5a1fabfc4c8e922d9bd7398908c77) and 9.0.0-M2 (2aa6cb34052d516a3c7d5105b03d5941ac0623aa) vulnerable, while 8.0.4 (557297751e3138cbd6e940b6c98085d93037c4ad) and 9.0.0-M3 (85f901dccbd0ca770dece8cb539d0ddf99ca03aa) use the session-bound endpoint. The first-party 8.0.4 release notes https://github.com/eclipse-ee4j/glassfish/releases/tag/8.0.4 list PR #26081. AI attribution: git show --format=raw --no-patch on only BIC 8d7b7ae8846487c31b375426c8babde8f1024f18 shows the human author/committer and only the GLASSFISH issue subject plus git-svn-id, with no AI marker. introducer_parent corrected from 25567105f6d0b29facc017f86531677228cf74c1 to null (root commit; reconciliation 2026-08-29: `git log -1 --format=%P 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb` empty (root commit; `git cat-file -p 57171473` shows no parent line).)
reasoning: Field reconciliation 2026-08-29 (see evidence tail). The vulnerable lifecycle starts in original GlassFish SVN r52295: 8d7b7ae8846487c31b375426c8babde8f1024f18 created the LogViewer content source, accepted restUrl from the inbound request, used it as the outbound origin, and invoked a helper that forwarded the session REST token. Its direct parent has no such file, so absence is proven and the commit is the smallest causal change. The Eclipse repository's 2018 root merely aggregates the already-vulnerable source and was therefore decomposed rather than misclassified as the BIC. The flaw persists in the advisory's 6.2.5 and in later tagged branches. Direct fix baa1bb56b137773a6ca921a35c60d32414a68f2f removes attacker control of the origin by using session REST_URL; adjacent vulnerable/fixed tag pairs establish the landing boundary at 8.0.4 and 9.0.0-M3, although 7.x remains unpatched in its latest tags. Finally, only the BIC commit object was used for attribution: it is a 2012 human git-svn commit with no AI marker, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
